nodes.label: ADR 0129: Refresh the code map's docs in every session that changes them, without the skill; browse it on the site
nodes.rationale: The vault is always current source of truth. Every session that changes docs in the graph refreshes them before commit to avoid 60 KB instruction overhead per session. Measured cost: ~73k subagent tokens per refresh on Haiku.

nodes.label: ADR 0128: Code map built on GitHub
Tie code to decisions via ADR comments
nodes.rationale: Every ADR's main node is labelled from its heading; code's 'ADR 0124' comments become nodes with edges to that ADR, enabling affected file queries to reach ADRs it cites

nodes.label: Lease-based concurrent graph publishing
nodes.rationale: graph.yml publishes with a lease; if branch moved since fetch (docs refresh), it fetches again and updates on top, up to three times, preventing overwrites during concurrent publishes

nodes.label: .graphifyignore: vault/log/ exclusion
nodes.rationale: changelog, handoff and archive are excluded because changelog is long (expensive to re-read) and both change in every session

nodes.label: Interactive graph view on website
nodes.rationale: Graph's interactive view hosted at https://joaopmanso.github.io/glue/graph/; graph.html published with graph and copied from branch to website

nodes.label: Documentation refresh in batches
nodes.rationale: prepare step lists changed docs and writes one prompt per batch of 15; one subagent per batch reads docs and writes .docs_NN.json
